description: Use this when a publisher without an account wants links ready to render on a site or app: it creates a provisional Clickwise affiliate and tracked links, as request_tracked_links does, and also returns cards, an HTML embed snippet and a JSON feed. Email is optional; the account is claimed later for payout. For plain links use request_tracked_links; with an existing API key use create_tracking_links.

claim_email.description: Optional email to claim the account (and payout) later.

program_ids.description: Optional specific program IDs; omit to let Clickwise pick fitting merchants.

publisher_url.description: The app/site/profile where the feed will be embedded.

topic.description: Audience/content topic, e.g. travel deals, AI shopping assistant, sneakers.

name: get_monetization_feed
title: Get monetization feed
